models_evaluated: Healthcare Agent Orchestrator (HAO) Patient History agent
unlisted_practices: Model-as-a-judge (TBFact) evaluation of LLM-generated patient summaries for completeness and succinctness against ground truth
Data-free local evaluation framework allowing institutions to assess summaries without sharing sensitive clinical data

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a multi-agent LLM system (Healthcare Agent Orchestrator) and an automated evaluation metric (TBFact) for patient summarization in molecular tumor boards on a retrospective dataset, without comparing deployment practices or safeguards.
